verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke publishes pricing pages with explicit hourly rate ranges (£190–£870 for immigration, £240–£870 for employment tribunal) and fixed fee estimates for specific matter types. So cost is not entirely opaque. However, this disclosure covers only two narrow practice areas, and nothing shows published pricing or billing practices for its core corporate, VC, IP or data work. Missing for 10: pricing or rate disclosure beyond immigration and employment-tribunal matters, any documented alternative fee arrangements, and general billing-practice statements across the firm.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm states publicly how engagements are priced — rate structures, alternative fee arrangements, or billing practices — rather than leaving cost entirely opaque

citations.quote: Our lowest hourly rate is £190, excluding VAT and our highest hourly rate is £870, excluding VAT.
Fees range from £25,000 to £35,000 excluding VAT
